canDoYue: 你識講訂位、提早入住、非吸煙房、行李，同埋問房間嘅無線網絡密碼。
canDoEn: Say the room is not ready, ask for a non-smoking room and early check in, and get the wifi password.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hello, I have a reservation, and I hope the room allows an early check in.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好，我有訂位，希望房間可以提早入住。
dialogue.say: Hello, I have a reservation, and I hope the room allows an early check in.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: The room is not ready yet, and your luggage can stay beside the desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 房間未準備好，行李可以放喺櫃檯旁邊。
dialogue.say: The room is not ready yet, and your luggage can stay beside the desk.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could we have a non-smoking room, and may I leave the luggage here?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以要一間非吸煙房，行李放喺度得唔得？
dialogue.say: Could we have a non-smoking room, and may I leave the luggage here?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: The non-smoking choice is free, and early check in starts after the other guest leaves.
dialogue.glossYue: 非吸煙選擇唔使加錢，上一位客人走咗先可以提早入住。
dialogue.say: The non-smoking choice is free, and early check in starts after the other guest leaves.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: What is the wifi password for the room when I go up later?
dialogue.glossYue: 我之後上去，房間嘅無線網絡密碼係咩？
dialogue.say: What is the wifi password for the room when I go up later?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: The wifi password is on the card beside the bed in the hall.
dialogue.glossYue: 無線網絡密碼喺走廊床邊張卡上面。
dialogue.say: The wifi password is on the card beside the bed in the hall.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I can wait for the room, and I will keep the luggage with me until four.
dialogue.glossYue: 我可以等房間，行李我自己拎住，直到四點。
dialogue.say: I can wait for the room, and I will keep the luggage with me until four.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Please come back for the room after four, and the desk will call your name.
dialogue.glossYue: 請四點之後返嚟取房間，櫃檯會叫你個名。
dialogue.say: Please come back for the room after four, and the desk will call your name.

understand.explain: reservation 係訂位。early check in 係提早入住。

問四點之後返唔返嚟取房間

understand.explain: wifi 係無線網絡。password 係密碼。
